description.zh:
要操作的WAF实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~)查询WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call [DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-clusters --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-uqm35000002 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
